data.name: Fitness Gym Bodybuilding Pump
data.detailed_description:
Are you ready to build the ultimate physique and dominate the ring and the stage?

Welcome to Fitness Gym Bodybuilding Pump—the ultimate gym simulator and bodybuilding game where you transform from a skinny beginner into a legendary heavyweight champion! Sweat, train, and click your way to massive gains in the most addictive workout clicker on Steam.

🏋️‍♂️ THE ULTIMATE GYM SIMULATION
Step into a fully equipped virtual gym. Take on dozens of muscle-pumping exercises targeting your chest, shoulders, biceps, triceps, abs, and legs. Master quick-time event workouts in this deep gym tycoon to maximize your gains, increase your lifting weights, and watch your character grow bigger and stronger in real-time!

🥊 RISE TO BOXING & COMPETITION STARDOM
Your hard work in the gym pays off in the competitive arena! Enter Career Mode to climb the ranks from an unknown amateur to a world-class Star of the Ring and Stage. Face off against unique opponents in intense arcade fighting challenges, test your absolute raw power in heavy powerlifting tournaments, dominate rival arm wrestling duals, and flex your gains on the professional bodybuilding stage. Grow your career in this bodybuilding simulator and unleash devastating jabs, hooks, uppercuts, and winning poses!

💪 GAME FEATURES:
• Real-Time Body Transformation: See your character visually bulk up as you level up your strength and training routine.
• Realistic Gym Simulator Mechanics: Complete a massive variety of authentic fitness and weightlifting movements.
• Multi-Discipline Competitions: Test your strength across distinct tournament modes including Boxing Combat, Arm Wrestling duals, Powerlifting max-outs, and Bodybuilding pose-offs.
• Thrilling Boxing Combat: Put your muscles to work with arcade-style fighting mechanics and special combos.
• Supplements & Upgrades: Spend your earnings on energy drinks, protein powders, and gainers to temporarily boost your stamina and supercharge your bodybuilding simulator muscle growth.
• Gear & Customization: Collect and equip powerful boxing gloves, lifting gear, and cool items to stand out in the fitness center, the tournaments, and the ring.
• Leaderboards & Achievements: Compete against friends and global players to see who can build the strongest character and win the most championship trophies.
• High-Energy Workout Tracker Soundtrack: Stay motivated with powerful, upbeat music and attractive, stylized graphics.

Don't just dream about the ultimate pump. Add Fitness Gym Bodybuilding Pump to your Wishlist today, crush your workouts, knock out your rivals, win every competition, and show the world what you are capable of in the premier gym simulator!

***

👑 IN-GAME SUBSCRIPTIONS
• Optional premium subscriptions are available in-game to enhance your gameplay experience, offering exclusive bonuses and faster progression.

💬 FEEDBACK & SUPPORT
• We are always happy to hear your thoughts and feedback! Please write to us through our official support channels.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100 (or equivalent mobile variants)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 (Integrated Intel Iris Xe is acceptable if optimization is prioritized)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 13 (Ventura) or newer
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 chip or better (Intel Macs are largely deprecated for new Steam releases)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Integrated GPU (8-core)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0+ or modern distributions like Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / Pop!_OS
  • Processor: AMD Zen 2 (4 Cores / 8 Threads) or Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RDNA 2 (Steam Deck APU) or NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
